purpose: Independent semantic cases frozen before reading implementation or developer tests/outputs
assertion_policy: Assert meaning rather than exact wording, score, candidate count, or incidental defaults. Clarification is mandatory only where explicitly marked. Exclusions must be grounded in their own affirmative attachment evidence. Expected geographies are ordered mentions. Data concepts referenced only as subjects of uncertainty are not automatically positive requests or exclusions.
